item.title: Early flu season may prompt consideration of vaccination
item.description: Flu season usually begins in October or November, but this year cases started rising in September.

item.title: Predicting the 2026 Nobel Prize in economics
item.description: A thinly traded prediction market offers a starting point as we examine potential winners and the ideas that could earn economics' top honor.

item.title: Mortgage and auto loan costs reach new highs
item.description: Mortgages hit their highest level in nearly three years, while car and education loans also grew more expensive.
